title: Customer runway stitching — April 2027
summary: Working sheet to reconcile per-contract reserved GPU commitments against regional availability for the next 12 weeks, plus an operational plan for stitching shortfalls using buffer pools and overflow routing.
assumptions: All reserved numbers are expressed as v100-equivalent 32GB GPUs. Buffer pool is pre-reserved but not fully committed. Forecast window is 12 weeks starting 2027-04-19. Avg util = 30-day trailing for contract's dedicated endpoints; peak week = highest weekly 95th percentile forecast from customer telemetry.
allocation_rows: Contract: AcmeCorp-prod | Region: us-west-2 | Reserved: 128 | AvgUtil: 62% | PeakWeekDemand: 192 | Runway(wks): 8 | ReassignableBuffer: 32 | Notes: short seasonal burst in retail search, priority=high
Contract: NovaAI-beta | Region: eu-central-1 | Reserved: 40 | AvgUtil: 44% | PeakWeekDemand: 56 | Runway(wks): 14 | ReassignableBuffer: 8 | Notes: non-critical, can be throttled to spot
Contract: HelixHealth-dev | Region: us-east-1 | Reserved: 64 | AvgUtil: 21% | PeakWeekDemand: 80 | Runway(wks): 26 | ReassignableBuffer: 16 | Notes: regulated, prefer on-prem fallback if available

Contract: TradeSphere-prod | Region: ap-southeast-1 | Reserved: 96 | AvgUtil: 79% | PeakWeekDemand: 140 | Runway(wks): 6 | ReassignableBuffer: 0 | Notes: sustained high usage, consider autoscale uplift or dedicated burst
Contract: BrightLearn-staging | Region: us-west-2 | Reserved: 12 | AvgUtil: 10% | PeakWeekDemand: 18 | Runway(wks): 52 | ReassignableBuffer: 6 | Notes: can be preempted for bursts
capacity_summary: Total reserved (sheet sample): 340 GPUs across listed contracts. Calculated peak-week demand sum = 486 GPUs. Current regional buffer pool (global) = 120 GPUs (40 us-west-2, 40 us-east-1, 40 eu-central-1). Shortfall in peak week if all peaks coincide = 26 GPUs after using buffer and cross-region routing assuming 80% successful failover. Operational target: reduce coincident shortfall to < 10 GPUs by re-slicing low-priority reservations and incenting scheduled bursts.
recommendations: 1) Create a scheduled burst policy for TradeSphere-prod to shift 20% of non-peak work to off-peak window; 2) Move BrightLearn-staging into preemptible pool to free 6 GPUs in us-west-2; 3) Open a minor one-time temporary uplift (30 GPUs) in us-west-2 from spare capacity marketplace during weeks 17-20; 4) For HelixHealth, validate on-prem fallback by 2027-04-30 (security approvals in CONFL-9323).

open_questions: If two peak events overlap in adjacent regions, can we guarantee <100ms cold-start for autoscale uplift?
Is the 40-GPU per-region buffer an operational minimum or can we rebalance to 60/30/30 temporarily?
What are contract penalties if we throttle dedicated endpoints during scheduled relief windows (legal review needed)?
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: simultaneous peaks from 2+ high-priority customers can exceed buffer and cause throttling. Mitigation: short-term capacity uplift via marketplace + prioritized routing and targeted customer throttles with SLA credits agreed in advance.
